input_narrative: SYNTHETIC NARRATIVE: Synthetic cardiology ward reported that the patient lost consciousness and required emergency resuscitation following an unflagged complete atrioventricular block episode, confirmed by hospital emergency response records. The emergency-response record and the device telemetry log disagree on episode onset time by several minutes, an unresolved discrepancy that does not change the outcome.

risk_report.rationale: The incident narrative describes a patient experiencing loss of consciousness and requiring emergency resuscitation following an unflagged complete atrioventricular block episode. This represents a serious potential patient-safety risk (severity 3) because it involves a failure or missed detection in a safety-critical function that might have led to serious harm, even if no harm actually occurred in the reported event. The disagreement between emergency response records and device telemetry logs regarding the onset time of the episode warrants investigation.  The EU MDR mandates requirements for electronic programmable systems (ID: mdr-annexI-sec17.1-electronic-programmable), including ensuring repeatability, reliability, and performance aligned with intended use, and mitigating risks in case of fault conditions. Furthermore, software development must adhere to a lifecycle incorporating risk management and cybersecurity (ID: mdr-annexI-sec17.2-software-lifecycle).  The incident also implicates design controls for devices automated with computer software (ID: qmsr-820.10-c-design-development), requiring adherence to ISO 13485 standards. While the telemetry logs and emergency response records disagree, this discrepancy does not change the outcome; however, it highlights a potential issue in data synchronization or reporting that needs investigation. The device confidence score logs (ID: ARTIFACT-TESTLOG-2025A, ID: ARTIFACT-TESTLOG-2029A) are relevant technical artifacts for assessing the performance of the detection algorithm and identifying any contributing factors to the missed episode.
